method: All local scientific files rehashed with SHA256; each remote GCS size and MD5 (or CRC32C for five composite objects) compared with local bytes. Manifest independently downloaded and matched byte for byte. Checksum-only rsync dry run reported zero transfers. Large objects were not individually downloaded.
exclusions: W&B service/cache files (online runs and standalone local records retained separately); raw compiler cache (retained as source/inductor-cache.tar.gz); verification receipts and storage.json; Python caches.
notes: The immutable manifest covers 137 scientific artifacts; its own bytes and retention receipts are outside the manifest to avoid self-reference.
The compiler cache used in the successful recovery control is retained as source/inductor-cache.tar.gz.
The W&B SDK cache files are excluded; standalone reports, plots and online runs are retained.
All 136 manifest-listed historical BF16 artifacts were separately rehashed without changes.
This archive retains failed screens and the first failed cold-process recovery alongside successful confirmation and cache-control runs.
